name: Druid

pitch.newcomer: A shapeshifter who can be a bear, a cat, a healer or a star-caller, whatever the moment needs.
pitch.veteran: The ultimate hybrid: tank, heal, melee or caster DPS from one class.

strengths: Can fill every combat role with the right gear and talents.
Strong healer, and a capable tank and damage dealer.
weaknesses: Weaker, less reliable crowd control; heal-over-time healing needs planning.

name: Hunter

pitch.newcomer: A ranged hunter with a loyal animal companion, or a lone wolf who needs no one.
pitch.veteran: Ranged physical DPS with pets, traps and the longest range in the game; petless via Lone Wolf.

strengths: Longest attack range of any class.
The pet can tank in solo and small-group play.
Talents support pet, ranged, trap-and-melee or petless builds.
weaknesses: Ranged attacks don't work within 8 yards.

name: Mage

pitch.newcomer: A master of arcane, fire and frost who rains destruction from afar, and conjures snacks for everyone.
pitch.veteran: Ranged caster DPS with top AoE, Polymorph and portals; new Frostfire Bolt and Arcane Blast.

strengths: Strong ranged single-target and area damage.
Crowd control (Polymorph), raid buffs, food and water.

name: Paladin

pitch.newcomer: A holy knight in heavy armor who can protect, heal or smite, and is very hard to kill.
pitch.veteran: Plate hybrid: tank, heal or melee; Seal of Fury tanking and Twist of Light seal twisting.

strengths: Very strong against Undead and Demons.
Effective tank, competitive damage dealer and strong single-target healer.
weaknesses: No interrupts and no movement slows.

name: Priest

pitch.newcomer: A healer of body and spirit, or a master of shadow who drains enemies' minds.
pitch.veteran: The most versatile healer (HoTs, direct heals, shields), with Shadow as a DoT caster.

strengths: The most versatile healer: heals over time, direct heals and shields.
Every priest gets Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at 20.
weaknesses: Fragile cloth wearer with few escapes.
Relies on tanks and allies for control; Shadow brings less utility than a Warlock.

name: Rogue

pitch.newcomer: A stealthy assassin who strikes from the shadows with blades and poison.
pitch.veteran: Melee DPS with stealth, poisons and control; Mutilate, Venom and Hack and Slash.

strengths: The only class with poisons; high single-target melee damage.
weaknesses: (Editorial) Brings little to a group beyond damage and control, and can't heal or tank.

name: Shaman

pitch.newcomer: A spirit-caller who commands the elements and plants totems to empower friends.
pitch.veteran: Totem hybrid: Elemental caster, Enhancement melee (small-group off-tank) or Restoration healer.

strengths: Totem mastery with party and raid buffs.
Flexible melee or spell damage plus strong healing; wears mail and a shield.
weaknesses: Depends on allies for control and survivability.

name: Warlock

pitch.newcomer: A dark caster who commands demons and drains the life of their foes.
pitch.veteran: DoT/drain caster with demon pets; Banes, Wrack, Demonic Pact and Incinerate.

strengths: Caster damage on par with other casters, in three distinct styles.
Demon pets protect you and scale with your stats.
weaknesses: Depends on demon pets for protection.

name: Warrior

pitch.newcomer: A fearless fighter in heavy armor: charge in, take the hits, hit harder.
pitch.veteran: Plate melee: Arms, Fury or Protection; rage rework, Victory Rush, Weaponmaster.

strengths: Melee specialist who deals and absorbs damage.
Great sustained damage against groups of melee enemies, with unique buffs and debuffs.
weaknesses: Struggles to recover from heavy damage.
